title: Death And Rebirth
description: Now that you've reached The Nether, you don't want to die and be sent back, do you? No, I'm certain that would be... undesirable. But a simple bed will not do, no, no. Instead, I implore you to craft a [Respawn Anchor](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/respawn_anchor.png:124:62). Fueled with blocks of glowstone, your very soul will be anchored to this plane.
